name: LayerFS
description: Gives each coding agent an ephemeral, writable workspace over shared copy-on-write history, so many agents can branch, commit and merge in parallel. For multi-agent system builders.

skills.name: Ephemeral workspaces
skills.description: Mounts a complete writable workspace over committed history for each command, then commits and unmounts.

skills.name: Recursive branching
skills.description: Forks a new branch from any commit at any depth so agents can try alternatives in parallel.

skills.name: Conflict rules
skills.description: Refuses conflicting commits to the same file unless a .lww rule says the newest edit wins.

skills.name: Auto checkpoints
skills.description: Records every agent step as a commit that the agent can return to.

skills.name: Deduplicated storage
skills.description: Chunks content and stores each chunk once in a single SQLite store shared by all agents.
